verdicts.reason: Both just ask whether the release clearly states its single main news item; no distinguishing property between them.
Lede/pyramid structure vs. 'About' boilerplate content are unrelated properties.
Lede/pyramid structure vs. M&A/SPAC deal-term disclosure are unrelated properties.
X is crisis-specific strategic posture; Y is general cross-channel narrative consistency applicable to any release.
Search/SEO optimization vs. disclosure of AI-generated content are unrelated properties.
Plain-language clarity vs. cultural/historical appropriateness are different properties.
Lede completeness vs. boilerplate 'About' section are unrelated properties.
Lede completeness vs. M&A/SPAC disclosure essentials are unrelated properties.
Event logistics essentials vs. M&A/SPAC deal disclosure are unrelated properties.
Message-reality/cross-channel consistency vs. audience segmentation/tailoring are different properties.
Message-reality/cross-channel consistency vs. cultural sensitivity are different properties.
Avoiding promotional tone/hype is separable from following AP grammar/style consistency; a release can satisfy one without the other.
Both score whether high-quality, reusable multimedia assets are provided in newsroom-ready form; X's technical specifics elaborate the same underlying property Y states more compactly.
Quote authenticity/informativeness vs. dateline formatting convention are unrelated properties.

Crisis response strategy vs. brand voice authenticity are different properties.
AP style/grammar consistency vs. logo/visual brand-asset compliance are different properties.
Authentic brand voice/creative coherence vs. mechanical compliance with logo/color/typography rules are different, independently-checkable properties.
Logo/brand-asset usage compliance vs. multimedia assets being publish-ready are different properties.

Brand voice authenticity vs. cultural/historical sensitivity are different properties.

AP style/grammar consistency vs. contact-detail availability/credibility are unrelated properties.
Broad evidence/sourcing/methods transparency vs. narrowly stating limitations/caveats are different in scope; X covers much more than Y tests.
Methodological disclosure enabling replication (X) vs. numeric claims having sourced provenance for editorial durability (Y) emphasize different properties.
